headline: "Even After Spending 40 Trillion Won, Why Is the Stock Price Like This?" Samsung-Hynix Plunge 7% and 9%+... Large-Scale Treasury Share Cancellation Not Enough? [Investment 360]
summary: The KOSPI closed at 6,471.17 on the 19th, down 5.80%. Foreigners net sold 3.4884 trillion won and institutions net sold 1.3231 trillion won, and Samsung and SK Hynix fell 7% and over 9%.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main equity benchmark, and Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are major weights in it through their memory-chip businesses.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Index closed down 5.80% after heavy net selling by foreign and institutional investors.

why_moved: Foreign and institutional investors net sold heavily, with foreigners selling about 3.49 trillion won. Large declines in the two memory-chip leaders dragged the index lower.
